title: ICASSP 2026 URGENT Speech Enhancement Challenge
summary: 把通用增强与增强语音质量评估放进同一挑战；覆盖多失真、多领域和多采样率，是 2026 年比较系统的首要基准。
architecture: Track 1 evaluates universal speech enhancement; Track 2 evaluates enhanced-speech quality assessment; both use shared data; baselines; and blind-test protocols.
limitations: 挑战分数仍受自动代理指标影响；不同队伍的训练数据和后处理可能不完全可比；真实设备分布仍不可能穷尽。

title: A Hybrid Discriminative and Generative System for Universal Speech Enhancement
summary: 以 TF-GridNet 保信号忠实度、以自回归生成补细节，再学习融合权重；在 URGENT 2026 Track 1 获第三名。
architecture: The discriminative branch uses a sampling-rate-independent TF-GridNet; the generative branch combines autoregressive modeling with spectral mapping; a fusion network is jointly optimized with signal-level and composite SQA losses.
limitations: 双分支训练和推理成本高；生成分支仍可能产生内容漂移；融合器会继承两侧偏差。

title: Hybrid Speech Enhancement with Discriminative and Codec Token Prediction Models Guided by Cleaned SSL Features for the ICASSP 2026 URGENT Challenge
summary: 用 cleaned SSL 特征同时指导判别式增强和 codec token 生成；在 URGENT 2026 主观评测获第二。
architecture: Early SSL layers are frozen or adapted to produce denoised representations; discriminative waveform or spectral branches run alongside a generative codec-token branch; their outputs are fused at the end.
limitations: 依赖较大的 SSL 与 codec 组件；token 生成可能损失音色；系统级消融和端侧延迟仍需关注。

title: GAP-URGENet: A Generative-Predictive Fusion Framework for Universal Speech Enhancement
summary: 生成分支负责表征域全栈恢复、预测分支负责谱域增强；在 URGENT 2026 盲测目标评估排名第一。
architecture: A generative branch restores self-supervised representations and reconstructs them with a vocoder; a predictive branch performs spectral enhancement; post-processing fuses both outputs and extends them to 48 kHz before resampling.
limitations: 两条链路和带宽扩展增加系统复杂度；声码器可能改写细节；挑战排名不代表所有真实场景。

title: UniPASE: A Generative Model for Universal Speech Enhancement with High Fidelity and Low Hallucinations
summary: 先得到语言内容忠实的增强表征再恢复声学细节，专门压低通用生成式增强的语言幻觉。
architecture: DeWavLM-Omni is distilled from WavLM and maps degraded waveforms to clean phonetic representations; an adapter generates acoustic representations; a vocoder and PostNet complete 16 or 48 kHz reconstruction.
limitations: 多模块级联依赖大规模监督数据；声码器和 PostNet 仍可能改变音色；低幻觉不等于零幻觉。

title: Multi-Metric Preference Alignment for Generative Speech Restoration
summary: 用质量、保真、内容和音色四类指标一致同意来构造 8 万对偏好数据；DPO 在 AR、MGM 与 flow 三类生成模型上都提升表现。
architecture: GenSR-Pref is built by consensus-ranking candidate restorations across multiple metrics; DPO is then applied separately to autoregressive; masked-generative; and flow-matching models.
limitations: 自动指标共识仍不等于真实人类偏好；筛选过程可能偏向已知代理；计算和数据成本较高。

title: Post-Training Speech Enhancement Language Models with Perceptual Rewards
summary: 直接用 DNSMOS、WER 和 UTMOS 作为 GSPO 奖励后训练增强语言模型；组合奖励优于任何单一奖励并减少 reward hacking。
architecture: UniSE and GenSE serve as autoregressive backbones; candidates are sampled in groups; sequence-level policy optimization uses a non-differentiable composite reward from multiple metrics.
limitations: 奖励模型自身有偏差；自回归采样慢；在 DNS2020 上的优势仍需跨语言、真实设备和说话人一致性验证。

title: SB-RF: Schrödinger Bridge Rectified Flow for One-Step Robust Speech Enhancement
summary: 把 Schrödinger bridge 的中间边缘分布与 rectified-flow 速度匹配结合，实现从带噪观测一次 Euler 更新到增强语音。
architecture: Training samples intermediate states from a bridge distribution and learns a conditional velocity field; inference starts from the observation and performs one deterministic transport step.
limitations: 一步近似在复杂真实退化下可能欠拟合；低延迟结论仍需报告设备 RTF；强先验仍有生成偏差。

title: Rethinking Language Model-Based Generative Speech Enhancement in the Latent Space of a Neural Audio Codec
summary: 在统一设置下比较离散/连续 AR、NAR、离散扩散和连续 flow 六种范式；连续潜变量整体优于离散，CNAR 最佳。
architecture: A shared neural audio codec provides discrete or continuous latent representations; six language-model variants use the same training and evaluation setup; all are fine-tuned with an auxiliary waveform-reconstruction loss.
limitations: 结论依赖所选 codec 与 URGENT 数据；连续 NAR 的优势未必迁移到端侧；需要人工听测与身份一致性分析。

title: Unified Diffusion Refinement for Multi-Channel Speech Enhancement and Separation
summary: 用干净语音 diffusion prior 对任意判别式多通道输出做免训练 refinement；同时覆盖增强与分离并可跨阵列泛化。
architecture: A noise spatial covariance matrix is estimated from the discriminative output and multichannel mixture; the SCM defines the posterior likelihood; sampling uses a pretrained clean-speech diffusion prior.
limitations: 需要多步 posterior sampling；SCM 估计错误会误导生成；训练免费不等于推理便宜。

title: RT-SEMamba: Real-Time Speech Enhancement Mamba via Progressive Knowledge Distillation
summary: 用固定大小状态替代 Transformer 增长的 KV cache；八层教师蒸馏到一层学生，在 25 ms 算法延迟下兼顾质量和速度。
architecture: A causal time-frequency Mamba models long-range context; progressive knowledge distillation constrains both complex-spectrum outputs and intermediate representations; the student keeps constant memory at steady state.
limitations: VoiceBank-DEMAND 较理想；真实长会话与设备噪声尚需验证；蒸馏会压缩困难条件下的性能上限。

title: RT-Tango: Real-Time Distributed Binaural Speech Enhancement for Low-Power Hearing Aid Devices
summary: 面向低功耗助听器的分布式双耳增强，以 ERB 压缩、分组循环掩码和时间稀疏化做到最低 8 ms 延迟。
architecture: The left and right devices collaborate in two stages; an asymmetric STFT decouples frequency resolution from algorithmic latency; spatial statistics are estimated online for causal inference.
limitations: 设备间通信与同步仍是部署瓶颈；轻量化限制极端混响表现；双耳线索需结合听测评估。

title: ABSE-NET: A Lightweight Neural Model for Active Binaural Speech Enhancement in Open-Fit Hearing Aids
summary: 把双耳增强和开放式助听器的泄漏声主动控制统一起来，而且实际部署不需要耳内麦克风。
architecture: BMVDR first performs coarse enhancement; a lightweight encoder-decoder suppresses acoustic leakage and compensates for beamforming distortion; a fusion module models time-frequency dependencies with convolutional attention.
limitations: 依赖助听器声学路径建模；跨佩戴者和耳模的稳健性待验证；MVDR 误差会传到补偿网络。

title: A Novel Binaural Cue Preservation Loss for DNN-Based Binaural Speech Enhancement
summary: 提出左右谱关系重建损失和联合 ILD/IPD 损失，在不明显牺牲降噪的情况下减少双耳掩码造成的空间失真。
architecture: A binaural DNN estimates time-frequency masks; training either directly constrains the left-right reconstruction relationship or jointly models interaural level and phase differences.
limitations: 指标改善不保证定位听感；个体 HRTF、头动和移动声源仍可能破坏线索；依赖成对双耳训练数据。

title: Discriminative-Generative Target Speaker Extraction with Decoder-Only Language Models
summary: 判别式前端负责选对人和压干扰，decoder-only codec LM 负责恢复自然度；比纯判别或纯生成更平衡。
architecture: The LauraTSE generative backbone autoregressively reconstructs codec representations; a two-stage framework compares freezing; joint fine-tuning; SI-SDR regularization; and AR versus NAR inference.
limitations: 自回归延迟高；前端选错会被生成器放大；联合训练仍无法完全消除内容与音色漂移。

title: Mask2Flow-TSE: Two-Stage Target Speaker Extraction with Masking and Flow Matching
summary: 用掩码承担早期删除干扰，再以一次 flow 插入缺失细节；85M 参数、一步推理且尽量不伤害干净单人输入。
architecture: A lightweight convolutional masker first removes interference from the mixture; a speaker-conditioned DiT then reconstructs the masked spectrogram with one-step flow matching.
limitations: 先删后补会继承掩码错误；一步生成在真实混响或注册失配下仍需验证；85M 对端侧并不小。

title: AlphaFlowTSE: One-Step Generative Target Speaker Extraction via Conditional AlphaFlow
summary: 沿混合到目标的轨迹直接学习一次运输，不需要估计 mixture-dependent 时间坐标；在 REAL-T 上提升身份相似度和 ASR 泛化。
architecture: The model uses a JVP-free conditional AlphaFlow mean-velocity objective; flow matching is combined with an interval-consistency teacher-student objective to stabilize training.
limitations: 仍是 arXiv 预印本；一步运输对极端重叠可能不足；注册质量和目标静音段风险需单独报告。

title: StarTSE: Towards Streaming Target Speaker Extraction via Chunk-wise Interleaved Splicing of Autoregressive Language Model
summary: 用 chunk-wise interleaved splicing 消除训练与流式推理失配；在消费级 GPU 上报告 RTF 0.248。
architecture: An autoregressive generator interleaves input and output blocks; historical-context refinement repairs discontinuities at block boundaries and preserves long-range consistency during streaming.
limitations: 分块上下文仍可能漏掉远程线索；GPU 实时不代表端侧实时；自回归错误会随长会话累积。

title: WeSep: A Modular and Cue-Composable Framework for Target Speaker Extraction
summary: 把注册语音、空间、视觉和文本线索统一成可组合接口，便于系统研究线索缺失和跨模态交互。
architecture: Cue modules are decoupled from the separator backbone; a standardized cue-injection interface supports dynamic combinations of single or multiple modalities.
limitations: 统一接口不代表统一最优；不同线索的时序和可靠性差异仍大；真实缺失线索下的降级策略是关键。

title: LexTra: Folded Prompt and Split-Role Attention for Target Speaker Extraction
summary: 把长注册语音折成并行伪通道，并让注意力头分别负责注册交叉注意和混合自注意；提升噪声混响注册失配下的稳健性。
architecture: The enrollment utterance is split into equal segments and prepended to copies of the mixture; these are stacked along pseudo-channels; split-role heads separately capture identity and maintain stream consistency.
limitations: 并行副本增加显存；折叠长度仍需调参；依赖注册语音且在真实长会话中的身份漂移未知。

title: HRTF-guided Binaural Target Speaker Extraction with Real-World Validation
summary: 直接用目标 HRTF 作空间先验，在提取目标的同时保存双耳定位线索；同时报告仿真和 HATS 实录。
architecture: A multichannel deep blind-source-separation backbone is adapted for binaural TSE; training with HRTFs measured from multiple people supports cross-listener generalization.
limitations: 目前仍是投稿预印本；目标方向和 HRTF 必须可用；真实头动、移动声源与个体耳形差异仍是难点。

title: Flexible Multi-Channel Target Speaker Extraction Using Geometry-Conditioned Spatially Selective Non-linear Filters
summary: 用麦克风位置与目标方向共同条件化网络，显著缓解训练阵列和测试阵列几何不匹配。
architecture: A geometry branch combines DOA with microphone position encoding into DOA-MPE; FiLM modulates intermediate features of a spatially selective nonlinear filter.
limitations: 需要可靠的阵列坐标和 DOA；快速移动时条件更新可能滞后；随机阵列结果未必覆盖真实设备误差。

title: Weakly Guided and Autoregressive Beamformer Parameterization for Generalizable Moving Speaker Extraction in Higher-Order Ambisonics
summary: 只需目标初始方向，因果自回归地更新 beamformer；对快速移动、长录音、交叉轨迹和真实会议都做了验证。
architecture: Neural time-frequency modeling is first decoupled from linear spatial filtering for higher-order Ambisonics; frame-level autoregressive parameterization then continuously tracks the moving target.
limitations: 需要 ambisonics 或等价空间表示；初始方向错误会持续影响跟踪；多目标交叉时仍可能发生身份交换。

title: SLT 2026 REAL-TSE Challenge: Real-world Target Speaker Extraction from Conversational Recordings
summary: 把 TSE 从模拟朗读语音推进到中英文真实会话；明确包含自然重叠、混响、噪声、通道失配和会话动态。
architecture: The benchmark defines a low-latency Online track and a full-context Offline track; enrollment speech specifies the target; evaluation jointly covers content; identity; quality; and activity detection.
limitations: 挑战数据和语言仍有限；综合指标权重影响排名；真实会话的干净参考不完美。

title: ARTT: Augmented Reverberant-Target Training for Unsupervised Monaural Speech Dereverberation
summary: 不需要干净参考：先把观测再混响并学习还原原观测，所得网络反而能削弱混响；再用在线自蒸馏提升。
architecture: A first-stage RTT recovers the original reverberant signal from twice-reverberated input; a second-stage mean teacher performs online self-distillation to produce more stable pseudo-targets.
limitations: 逆问题仍不适定；二次混响的设计决定偏置；对移动房间和重叠说话的适用性未知。

title: Deep Filter Estimation from Inter-Frame Correlations for Monaural Speech Dereverberation
summary: 不直接黑盒映射复谱，而从帧间相关估计每个时频点的多帧滤波器；在 REVERB RealData 上显著改善 SRMR。
architecture: Inter-frame STFT correlations are explicitly extracted; a correlation-to-filter network generates multi-frame deep filters; the filtering constraint narrows the solution space.
limitations: 仍依赖相关结构假设；SRMR 提升不一定等于 ASR 或听感提升；对强非平稳噪声和时变房间需验证。

title: DDNet: A Task-Decoupled Two-Stage Network for Multi-Channel Speech Denoising and Dereverberation
summary: 把降噪和去混响明确拆成两阶段，避免单网络同时优化两类退化时互相牵制。
architecture: DenoiserNet combines a U-Net; complex ratio masking; Tri-Spectral Attention; and skip attention for denoising; DereverberNet uses an enhanced DPRNN to model long-tail reverberation.
limitations: 级联误差明显；两阶段推理成本高；固定顺序不一定适合混响与噪声强度快速变化的场景。

title: E2E-AEC: Implementing an End-to-End Neural Network Learning Approach for Acoustic Echo Cancellation
summary: 不依赖传统 LAEC 和显式时延估计，通过渐进学习、LAEC 知识迁移和注意力对齐实现流式端到端 AEC。
architecture: The system is initialized from a pretrained LAEC-based model; an alignment loss is applied to attention weights; VAD controls the output during near-end silence to strengthen echo removal.
limitations: 端到端模型对未见扬声器非线性和超长时延仍敏感；VAD 错误可能截断近端语音。

title: LMPAN: A Lightweight Multi-Path Alignment Network for Joint Full-Duplex Acoustic Echo Cancellation and Noise Suppression
summary: 仅 480K 参数；在参考、LAEC 输出和麦克风三条路径间同时校正时间与能量失配，并兼顾 ASR/VAD。
architecture: A multipath alignment stage corrects three input streams; attention dynamically fuses enhanced LAEC and microphone features; dynamic-target post-filtering supports downstream tasks.
limitations: 仍依赖前置 LAEC；动态目标生成可能偏向 ASR 而非听感；硬件非线性覆盖需要更多真实测试。

title: Echo-Aware Modulation for Compact-Latent Frequency-Time Modeling in Lightweight Acoustic Echo Cancellation
summary: 在 0.2M 参数和 100M FLOPs/s 下，用 echo-aware modulation 补回 Bark 压缩瓶颈损失的时频建模能力。
architecture: LAEC is followed by a dual-branch asymmetric encoder; the EAM modulates compressed representations using differences and correlations between microphone and echo-related latent features.
limitations: Bark 压缩仍会损失窄带细节；依赖 LAEC 质量；论文中复杂度优势不等于所有芯片上的能耗优势。

title: DiffVQE: Hybrid Diffusion Voice Quality Enhancement Under Acoustic Echo and Noise
summary: 首个拓扑、训练数据和框架均可复现的 diffusion AEC/VQE 模型；在作者设置中超过判别式 DeepVQE。
architecture: Far-end reference; microphone input; and degradation conditions drive noncausal diffusion restoration; URGENT 2025 data broadens the coverage of noise and speech conditions.
limitations: 当前明确为非因果，不能直接用于实时通话；生成式双讲可能伤害近端内容；跨真实设备证据仍有限。

title: Speech Enhancement and Dereverberation with Diffusion-based Generative Models
summary: 统一处理降噪与去混响的经典 score-based 基线，强调跨数据集泛化与感知质量。
architecture: A time-dependent score is learned in the complex STFT domain; a reverse SDE progressively samples clean speech from a state near the noisy observation.
limitations: 典型设置需要约 30 次网络评估；结果依赖噪声调度，且强退化下有再生偏差。

title: StoRM: A Diffusion-based Stochastic Regeneration Model for Speech Enhancement and Dereverberation
summary: 用判别式预测先给出锚点，再由扩散细化，代表生成式与判别式融合路线。
architecture: A predictive network produces an initial enhanced estimate; a score model then performs stochastic regeneration conditioned on that estimate and the mixture.
limitations: 仍需迭代采样；预测器偏差会传给生成器；低 SNR 下需警惕说话内容幻觉。

title: SE-Bridge: Speech Enhancement with Consistent Brownian Bridge
summary: 把 Brownian Bridge 与一致性模型结合，显著减少扩散采样成本，并测试 ASR 与说话人验证。
architecture: The model learns a consistent mapping from states on the same probability-flow ODE trajectory to clean speech; enabling few-step or even one-step restoration.
limitations: 加速并未消除生成式保真风险；跨语言和真实设备的稳健性仍需独立验证。

title: Extract and Diffuse: Latent Integration for Improved Diffusion-based Speech and Vocal Enhancement
summary: 先提取判别式潜表示再扩散，直接针对生成式模型自然度高但内容保真不足的问题。
architecture: A discriminative enhancer provides a content latent; a conditional score network restores fine detail during generation.
limitations: 双模型带来训练与推理复杂度；上游潜表示错误可能限制生成结果。

title: SELM: Speech Enhancement Using Discrete Tokens and Language Models
summary: 把增强改写为离散语音 token 的语言建模，展示语义先验对主观自然度的帮助。
architecture: SSL features are discretized with k-means; a Transformer predicts clean tokens; a detokenizer and HiFi-GAN synthesize the waveform.
limitations: 量化会损失音色和细粒度声学信息；自回归解码慢，并可能改写内容。

title: Generative Pre-training for Speech with Flow Matching
summary: 以 6 万小时无标注语音预训练同一生成模型，再适配增强与分离，是通用生成式前端的重要方向。
architecture: A continuous flow is learned under masking conditions to transport a simple distribution to the speech distribution; the model is then fine-tuned for enhancement.
limitations: 预训练与适配成本高；通用能力不等于低延迟；任务输出保真仍需专项约束。

title: FlowSE: Efficient and High-Quality Speech Enhancement via Flow Matching
summary: 用条件 flow matching 缩短生成路径，并可选用转写文本来约束内容。
architecture: A continuous velocity field maps noisy mel features to clean mel features; a vocoder then reconstructs the waveform; optional text conditioning strengthens semantic consistency.
limitations: 依赖声码器且可能改变说话人细节；文本条件需要 ASR 或标注；尚非严格实时证据。

title: MP-SENet: A Speech Enhancement Model with Parallel Denoising of Magnitude and Phase Spectra
summary: 显式并行估计幅度与相位，代表高性能确定性复谱映射路线。
architecture: After convolutional encoding; a time-frequency Transformer models the signal; shared representations feed separate magnitude-mask and phase decoders.
limitations: 监督映射容易过平滑且依赖配对数据；相位分支难训练，跨域性能会下降。

title: TF-GridNet: Integrating Full- and Sub-Band Modeling for Speech Separation
summary: 用网格块交替建模帧内频率结构和跨帧时间结构，成为分离与增强的强骨干。
architecture: Complex STFT features repeatedly interact through frequency BLSTMs; time BLSTMs; and full-band attention before direct mapping to the target spectrum.
limitations: 模型较重且非因果版本延迟高；长序列注意力耗费显存；任务迁移仍需训练。

title: SpatialNet: Extensively Learning Spatial Information for Multichannel Joint Speech Separation, Denoising and Dereverberation
summary: 把空间向量的窄带动态与跨频谱结构分开建模，是多通道联合前端的代表工作。
architecture: Narrow-band spatial modules and cross-band spectral modules are stacked alternately to jointly separate; denoise; and dereverberate complex spectra.
limitations: 离线模型计算量较高；阵列几何与仿真到实录的失配会削弱空间线索。

title: Multichannel Long-Term Streaming Neural Speech Enhancement for Static and Moving Speakers
summary: 少数明确评测长音频和移动说话人的多通道流式工作，比较注意力、Retention 与 Mamba。
architecture: Causal attention; Retention; or state-space modules replace the temporal modeling in offline SpatialNet; followed by long-sequence fine-tuning.
limitations: 移动轨迹和真实阵列覆盖仍有限；状态记忆可能随超长会话漂移；空间失配敏感。

title: ClearerVoice-Studio: Bridging Advanced Speech Processing Research and Practical Deployment
summary: 把增强、分离和目标说话人提取做成可复用开源系统，适合作为实验与部署入口。
architecture: A unified interface wraps multiple pretrained time-domain and frequency-domain networks and provides both offline and streaming inference pipelines.
limitations: 系统论文覆盖面广但不代表单一架构创新；模型间数据和指标未必可直接横比。

title: Target Speech Extraction with Conditional Diffusion Model
summary: 较早验证条件扩散可用于 TSE，并通过多次采样集成减少选错目标的风险。
architecture: Reverse diffusion is conditioned on the mixture and a target clue; multiple samples are selected or fused through an ensemble strategy.
limitations: 随机采样存在目标混淆；集成进一步放大推理成本；注册条件质量敏感。

title: Conditional Diffusion Model for Target Speaker Extraction
summary: 在复数 STFT 域用 ECAPA 嵌入条件化 score model，并研究对特定说话人的微调。
architecture: An SDE diffuses the target source into a Gaussian distribution centered on the mixture; the reverse process alternately injects time and speaker embeddings.
limitations: 多步采样慢；嵌入泄漏和注册失配会导致错人；个性化微调增加维护成本。

title: Binaural Selective Attention Model for Target Speaker Extraction
summary: 以双耳线索与目标嵌入联合选择说话人，直接覆盖本库重点关注的 binaural TSE。
architecture: A time-domain FaSNet processes both ears; multi-head selective attention injects the target embedding; correlation-based and cosine-based binaural interactions are compared.
limitations: 当前验证以模拟和静态场景为主；头动、移动声源、个体 HRTF 与真实混响仍待扩展。

title: Multi-Channel Target Speaker Extraction with Refinement: The WavLab Submission to the Second Clarity Enhancement Challenge
summary: 面向助听器的困难噪声混响场景，把多通道 TSE、迭代波束形成与 5 ms 延迟约束放在一起。
architecture: A causal multichannel TF-GridNet produces an initial estimate; iNeuBe iterates neural enhancement and beamforming while injecting speaker conditioning.
limitations: 系统复杂且依赖阵列与听力图；仿真到真实房间存在明显落差。

title: Beamformer-Guided Target Speaker Extraction
summary: 用目标方向波束形成结果替代或补充注册语音，展示空间 clue 如何指导单通道 TSE。
architecture: A front-end beamformer steers toward the target; its output forms a time-varying auxiliary embedding that conditions a single-channel extractor.
limitations: 需要可靠 DOA；目标移动时波束跟踪误差会累积；相近方向说话人仍难区分。

title: SpeakerBeam-SS: Real-time Target Speaker Extraction with Lightweight Conv-TasNet and State Space Modeling
summary: 用状态空间模型压缩因果 Conv-TasNet 的长期依赖成本，聚焦真正可部署的流式 TSE。
architecture: The TasNet front-end window is lengthened and its encoder overparameterized; an SSM replaces stacked dilated convolutions for long-range context modeling.
limitations: 轻量化限制极端重叠下的分离能力；单通道仍缺乏空间判别线索。

title: Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction with Reverse Selective Auditory Attention
summary: 利用唇动在无需注册语音时锁定目标，并显式建模需要抑制的干扰成分。
architecture: Audio-visual encoders produce target cues; forward and reverse selective attention respectively emphasize the target and suppress interference.
limitations: 遮脸、不同步和低帧率会使视觉条件失效；摄像头带来隐私与部署成本。

title: Binaural Target Speaker Extraction using HRTFs
summary: 以 HRTF 而非说话人注册为条件，强调提取后仍保存目标方向的双耳线索。
architecture: A fully complex-valued network performs target-HRTF-conditioned mapping on left and right STFTs while suppressing reverberation.
limitations: 需要目标方向与匹配 HRTF；个体差异和移动场景会造成条件失配。

title: USDnet: Unsupervised Speech Dereverberation via Neural Forward Filtering
summary: 无需干净标签，用多麦克风重构约束训练去混响网络，适合真实场景数据。
architecture: A network estimates dereverberated speech; linear filtering such as FCP then uses that estimate to reconstruct each mixture channel and create a self-supervised constraint.
limitations: 依赖过定多通道和单源假设；错误的滤波可产生退化解；不适合任意重叠说话。

title: DeepVQE: Real Time Deep Voice Quality Enhancement for Joint Acoustic Echo Cancellation, Noise Suppression and Dereverberation
summary: 单一实时模型联合 AEC、降噪与去混响，并在公开挑战和实际通信平台验证。
architecture: A residual CNN encodes near-end and far-end spectra; cross-attention aligns and fuses them; an RNN models temporal context before decoding the enhanced spectrum.
limitations: 多任务目标可能互相牵制；端到端模型难定位故障；设备非线性和时延漂移仍关键。

title: FADI-AEC: Fast Score Based Diffusion Model Guided by Far-end Signal for Acoustic Echo Cancellation
summary: 少数专门面向 AEC 的生成式工作，以远端信号设计噪声过程并将 score 网络压到每帧一次。
architecture: Far-end and near-end signals define the diffusion perturbation; the fast variant runs the score model once per frame to reconstruct near-end speech.
limitations: 生成式 AEC 证据仍少；单步近似可能牺牲困难双讲；跨设备实录与因果稳定性待验证。

title: An Exploration of Task-decoupling on Two-stage Neural Post Filter for Real-time Personalized Acoustic Echo Cancellation
summary: 用两阶段拆分消回声与噪声和干扰说话人抑制，说明联合任务未必适合一个网络一次完成。
architecture: The first stage removes echo; the second suppresses noise and non-target speech using multiscale speaker representations; alternative training orders are explored.
limitations: 级联会累积失真和延迟；说话人表示与阶段划分需要按数据调参。

title: ICASSP 2023 Acoustic Echo Cancellation Challenge
summary: 提供真实设备与合成数据、双讲场景、个性化赛道和 20 ms 延迟约束，是近年 AEC 比较的核心基准。
architecture: This is not a single model; systems are evaluated with standardized training and test data; online subjective tests; and a full-band AECMOS service.
limitations: 挑战排名不能替代跨设备泛化；客观指标仍需与听测和 ASR 一起解读。
